meta.subtitle: 18 real deadline changes from archived funder pages, mostly NIH, because NIH publishes every change as a dated notice you can check, plus unchanged pages as controls.
meta.superseded_rule: old date already passed at the after-snapshot, new date in a later cycle
meta.unverified_note: Pairs marked verified: false are run and listed but not counted in the headline figures: NSF 17-565 (program 5467) was found in the archive when a sampled control differed, and no official notice was checked.
meta.scope_note: scope 'NIH-wide notice': one NIH notice moved the date of several announcements, and this page is one of them.
